annotations.title: List the prepaid packs on sale

description: Every prepaid pack on sale: its id (the one buy_credits takes), name, what it buys, price in minor units ex VAT, currency and how many months the credits last. Optionally filter by kind. Costs nothing.

kind.description: Optional. uk_credits for UK TPS and CTPS checks, au_washes for Australian Do Not Call Register washes, dead_number_checks for live mobile (HLR) checks.

name: list_packs
